title: Paystride Visa Payroll Card Advantage Claim Forms: Liability Limit by Transaction and Report Timing
content:
The liability limit for a signed claim on the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Advantage plan follows the claimed transaction and the loss report.

- When the claimed transaction is a purchase and the plan applies Visa Zero Liability, which the Advantage plan does, the limit is zero.
- When the loss report was late, the limit is 500.00.
- Otherwise it is 50.00.

The loss counts as reported on the date of the account's single lost or stolen replacement order placed on or after the loss date, among its orders of the last 12 months. The report is late when it came more than 2 business days after the loss date. Business days are Monday through Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays, counted from the day after the earlier date through the later one. No transfer on such a claim is charged in full.

## Truth table

| Purchase | Report more than 2 business days after the loss date | Limit |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 0.00 |
| yes | no | 0.00 |
| no | yes | 500.00 |
| no | no | 50.00 |

*Hypothetical:* for a loss learned on a Tuesday with a stolen-card replacement ordered the following Monday, and no holiday, the report came 4 business days after the loss date and was late. An ATM withdrawal claim from that loss has a limit of 500.00.
